title: FlapLab Daily — He Doesn't Even Know How Stupid He Looks
story: You are the black-and-white cat whose fur pattern is a full receding hairline (and from the back, a perfect bald spot). He has no idea. The barbershop is open and the barber poles keep spinning toward him. Flap past them before someone offers a comb-over.
inspiration: Viral X post 'this cat doesn't even know how stupid it looks' (2113665255088017698, 23 Oct 2026, 130k+ likes): a white cat with a black 'receding hairline' pattern and a bald spot seen from behind. Cat cut out from the post photo with rembg; barber pole (Jacksonville, Florida, LoC) and museum barbershop photos from Wikimedia Commons.
